summary.name: Lunacy
summary.one_liner: Lunacy is a free graphic design and UI/UX editor from Icons8 that opens and edits Sketch files, with built-in icons, photos, and UI kits.
use_cases: editing Sketch files without a Sketch license
converting Figma files to Sketch format
self-hosting a design environment on a private network
summary.what_it_does: Lunacy is a design editor for Windows, macOS, and Linux that can open and edit Sketch files. It includes auto layout for responsive designs, components and variables, and prototyping into clickable flows. It offers real-time collaboration and online and offline modes. Built-in assets include icons, illustrations, photos, and UI kits, plus tools to remove photo backgrounds and generate placeholder text and avatars. The page also describes Lunacy Cloud, a self-hosted option for team use.
notable: Built-in Icons8 icons, illustrations, photos and UI kits
Lunacy Cloud self-hosting with bunker mode for closed networks
Auto shape colors, auto z-index and auto-updating generated content
caveats: Paid tiers listed at $8 to $12 per month alongside a free tier; exact feature split not stated on the page
Icons MCP and AI features are mentioned but details are not given
The iOS platform is only listed via an App Store link in a third-party list, not as a clear platform claim
